ops.prevDaySetup: Usage time includes setup and cleanup time (price list). Advance receipt of packages is in principle for arrival on the day before the event, and an advance load-in notice is required (items are accepted only on the day before use). Packages received in advance are in principle limited to 2 boxes per room. Except for some areas, the venue can be used 24 hours a day, 365 days a year. (Source: Price List updated July 3, 2026; Advance Load-in Notice; FAQ)
ops.loadingHours: Delivery vehicles for load-in and load-out must enter and leave within the usage time. An advance load-in notice must be submitted at least 1 week before the work date (the loading area cannot be used if it is not submitted). The vehicle load-in entrance is on B2F; the load-in door is 1,100 mm wide x 2,000 mm high, and the permitted dimensions of the loading area are 3,000 mm high x 4,700 mm long (up to 2-ton trucks; long trucks not allowed). For loading and unloading at the loading area, the equipment list (updated September 11, 2026) says within 30 minutes, while the Advance Load-in Notice says in principle within 20 minutes, so the official documents differ. For hand-cart load-in, use the 1F on weekdays 8:00-18:00; on weekdays after 18:00 and on Saturdays, Sundays and holidays, use the back door or the elevator from B1F. (Source: Conference Room Equipment List updated September 11, 2026; Advance Load-in Notice; Approach to the Venue)
ops.vehicleRules: The loading area is used only for loading and unloading; if parking is needed, use an outside parking lot. When multiple vehicles are used, they share one vehicle's loading space in staggered turns. Illegal parking and roadside parking around the building outside the designated parking lot are strictly prohibited. Delivery vehicles are limited to 3,000 mm high x 4,700 mm long and 2.0 t in weight; long trucks are not allowed. Products, packing materials, trash and the like may not be left in the loading area during the usage period. (Source: Advance Load-in Notice; Conference Room Equipment List updated September 11, 2026; Terms of Use 2026ver2 Articles 15 and 16)
ops.parking: There is no Bellesalle-dedicated parking lot, no hourly parking lot, and no drive-up entrance. To find nearby hourly parking lots, search for "Bellesalle Yaesu" on "s-park" (Tokyo Metropolitan Road Improvement and Conservation Corporation), which is linked from the official facility page. (Source: Conference Room Equipment List updated September 11, 2026; official facility page)
ops.waitingRooms: There is one waiting room each on the 2F and 3F (18㎡ each). The usage fee is 30,800 yen for 4 hours, 42,900 yen for 8 hours and 55,000 yen for 12 hours (each tax included). Each room has 1 table, 8 chairs, a clothes rack, a full-length mirror and a refrigerator. (Source: Price List updated July 3, 2026; Conference Room Equipment List updated September 11, 2026)
ops.catering: Outside food/drink brought in is allowed. However, if a caterer other than the operator's designated vendors is used, an "outside food/drink fee" applies (party use only; bringing in drinks only or boxed meals is not covered). The amount depends on venue area: up to 300㎡ 100,000 yen, up to 600㎡ 200,000 yen, up to 900㎡ 300,000 yen, up to 1,200㎡ 400,000 yen, 1,201㎡ and above 500,000 yen (110,000 to 550,000 yen each, tax included). (Source: Outside Food/Drink Fee Guide PDF, FAQ)
ops.restaurants: Party menus suitable for receptions are introduced on the website of Izumi Restaurant, a Sumitomo Fudosan Group company. (Source: FAQ)
